calls: QUIET WEEK: no Run 10 call overturned. RFW lineup still unpublished in the latest source (written Oct 3). Cucinelli Q3 (Oct 15) and Zegna Q3 (Oct 22) not yet out. Fresh Highsnobiety and Hypebeast searches returned only shop pages.

TENSION: Trendalytics classic-fit suiting +44% adoption, double-breasted +4%, pointed shoulders +12% vs the soft-construction runway consensus (Runs 08-10). Likely retail lag; only 5 of 10 trends readable. Open.

NEW: Ralph Lauren Fall 2026 shows casual and tailored as one wardrobe; Purple Label softens fit. Aubergine named most popular runway shade (Harrods); leather bombers +28%; statement collars and cuffs a detail trend.

NEW LEAD: ILLIYEEN (Dubai) luxury ready-to-wear thobes, planning Saudi entry (sponsored source, Mar 2025). Isaia, Eleventy, Corneliani first Saudi openings. Italian soft tailoring is now crowded in-country.
OPEN: follower recount (fourth run without), ILLIYEEN verification, full Trendalytics list, SADF menswear prices.
